shortDescription: Dungeons from Alexander Wales' "This Used to Be About Dungeons": levelled sites across the world map that generate a fresh themed pocket map per party, stocked with Titan Framework creatures and Entad Framework rewards.
body:
## Status
Build order: 1 World → 2 Entry → 3 Map generation → 4 Creatures → 5 Rewards → 6 Vehicle Framework.
Phase 1 done and tested (summary commit 35fdd06, builds 1-8). Highlight rings (build 8) not yet seen in game.
Phase 2 written (builds 9-12, reviewed at 11), not yet tested.

## World (phase 1)
- `DungeonWorldComponent`: dungeons as plain data (surface tile id + level), saved as byte arrays, with `genVersion`, `generatedMaxLevel`. `enteredBy`: per tile, load ids of pawns who entered (`HasEntered`/`MarkEntered`), cleared by Generate.
- Placement: seeded random order, BFS-blocked radius spacing-1. Land only unless Vehicle Framework + ocean setting.
- Levels: 3-octave Perlin over the unit sphere, ranked, level = 1 + floor(p^skew × max).
- Blocked = a MapParent other than our own DungeonSite on the tile.
- `WorldDrawLayer_Dungeons`: one batched mesh, custom UVs so the sprite points north, tint by level.
- Bottom-right toggles: show/hide icons, open dungeon finder. Tile inspect "Dungeon: level N". Vanilla world search lists "Dungeon (level N)".
- `Dialog_DungeonFinder`: party checklist (load caravan, untick retainers), level range, distance from colony/caravan, results with highlight rings (own texture World/TUBAD_Highlight).

## Entry (phase 2)
- Ways in: "Enter dungeon (level N)" caravan gizmo on a dungeon tile (disabled while moving or a party is inside); right-click a dungeon tile with a caravan selected (postfixes on both FloatMenuMakerWorld.ChoicesAtFor overloads; travels there with CaravanArrivalAction_EnterDungeon, then opens the dialog); a caravan formed with a dungeon as destination does the same.
- `Dialog_EnterDungeon`: vanilla split-caravan layout (pawns / items / travel supplies). Header: people n / cap (humanlikes only), party wealth, effective level with tooltip. Rules: at least one non-downed colonist; humanlikes ≤ cap; nobody who has entered this dungeon. If nobody able stays outside, every pawn goes in and unticked items wait in the site's stash.
- Party wealth = market value of the pawns going in + worn apparel + equipment (not inventory). Effective level = level × (1 + wealth / wealthToDouble), stored on the site for phases 4-5.
- `DungeonEntry.Enter`: long event; makes a `DungeonSite` (MapParent, WorldObjectDef TUBAD_DungeonSite) on the tile, generates a 100×100 map, splits the caravan the vanilla way, marks humanlikes as entered, enters with CaravanEnterMapUtility next to the exit, letter.
- One instance per dungeon. DungeonSite disables vanilla generic Enter, transport pod and shuttle options. A mapless leftover site is destroyed by CanEnterAt.

## Inside and leaving (phase 2)
- Placeholder map (`GenStep_DungeonPlaceholder`, replaced in phase 3): concrete floor, thick rock roof, a chain of rooms joined by 3-wide corridors cut out of TUBAD_DungeonWall, exit in the first room. Fog from the exit.
- TUBAD_DungeonWall: rock-atlas look, no hit points, not destroyable, mineable, deconstructible or targetable.
- `DungeonExit` (MapPortal subclass, CaveExit art): "Leave dungeon..." opens `Dialog_LeaveDungeon` (vanilla Dialog_EnterPortal with every reachable item, not only home area). Chosen pawns fetch chosen items, haul them in, and walk through. The portal leads to its own cell; pawns are queued and moved out next tick (join the caravan on the tile, or form one), carried items moved to inventory first; hauled items go to the site stash and then the caravan.
- Map removed when no living player humanlike or mech is spawned (downed counts as alive; corpses and animals don't). Site destroyed with it. "Party lost" letter when nobody came out. Stash goes to a waiting caravan if there is one.

## Settings (tabs)
- World: show icons, opacity 40%, tint by level, spacing 10, max level 30, low level bias 1.5, roughness 7, ocean dungeons with VF.
- Parties: max party size 5 (people only), wealth that doubles the level 50,000 (5k-300k).
- Planned: Creatures, Rewards.

## Agreed design (later phases)
- Map generation themed from surroundings, chambers divided by doors/rubble/vines; unbreakable outer walls with a normal inner layer possible.
- Creatures via Titan: humanlikes, animals, insects, mechs if feasible; points from effective level; packs; Dungeon Madness rules; tamable; suspended in undiscovered rooms.
- Rewards via EntadApi; binding single / party / unbound by settings.

## Textures
- World/TUBAD_Dungeon, World/TUBAD_Highlight, UI/TUBAD_ShowDungeons, UI/TUBAD_FindDungeons (placeholder SVG). Exit uses vanilla CaveExit art; enter gizmo vanilla EnterCave icon.

## Mockups
- .circinus/mockups/dungeon-finder.html
